sql.works: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),w.id,CASE WHEN w.publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN CAST(w.publication_year AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END,w.type,try_cast(regexp_extract(w.primary_location.source.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),coalesce(w.open_access.is_oa,false),coalesce(w.is_xpac,false),CAST(w.cited_by_count AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(w.primary_topic.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__') w WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(work_id,canonical_id,publication_year,work_type,source_id,is_oa,is_xpac,cited_by_count,primary_topic_id)
sql.work_author: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),a.author_position,coalesce(a.is_corresponding,false) FROM (SELECT id,unnest(authorships) AS a FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__')) WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(work_id,author_id,author_position,is_corresponding)
sql.work_institution: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(author_raw, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(institution.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM (SELECT id,a.author.id AS author_raw,unnest(a.institutions) AS institution FROM (SELECT id,unnest(authorships) AS a FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__'))) WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(author_raw, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(institution.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(work_id,author_id,institution_id)
sql.work_topic: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(topic.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),CAST(topic.score AS FLOAT),coalesce(try_cast(regexp_extract(topic.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT)=try_cast(regexp_extract(primary_raw, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),false) FROM (SELECT id,primary_topic.id AS primary_raw,unnest(topics) AS topic FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__')) WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(topic.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND topic.score IS NOT NULL) normalized(work_id,topic_id,score,is_primary)
sql.citation_edge: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),min(CASE WHEN publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN CAST(publication_year AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END) FROM (SELECT id,publication_year,unnest(referenced_works) AS ref FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__')) WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) normalized(citing_work_id,cited_work_id,citing_year)
sql.authors: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),id,display_name,nullif(orcid,'') FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__') WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(author_id,canonical_id,display_name,orcid)
sql.institutions: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),id,display_name,nullif(country_code,''),type FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__') WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(institution_id,canonical_id,display_name,country_code,institution_type)
sql.sources: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),id,display_name,nullif(issn_l,''),type FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__') WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(source_id,canonical_id,display_name,issn_l,source_type)
sql.topics: SELECT * FROM (SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),display_name,try_cast(regexp_extract(subfield.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(field.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT),try_cast(regexp_extract(domain.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM read_parquet('__INPUT__') WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(subfield.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(field.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(domain.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL) normalized(topic_id,display_name,subfield_id,field_id,domain_id)
